{"reason": "Failure rows show two unknown patterns that are truly demand-forecast-error: market-mismatch=#t events (e.g. amount=254000, 216000) and forecast-bias with bias-amount 0.065–0.081 just under the 0.1 threshold. I fold market-signal-mismatch into the forecast-error branch and lower the bias threshold to 0.05.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((or (and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
              (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
         (market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
